Name: Poke Furniture for Content Patcher
Author: SuperTriangle
Description:
Adds Pokemon themed furniture to Stardew Valley.
-Dolls
-Rugs
-Seats
-Pokeballs
They are set to randomly appear in shops. Download and extract. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ installed!
Contains custom edits and recolors. More to come in the future.
